method: Batch 46 (mobpush): the batch 45 creeperwitch harness (rows with the fifth element) where the probe also runs EntityPlayerMP.onUpdateEntity (mw.i: onLivingUpdate with the motion snap, moveEntity, the ground friction, then collideWithNearbyEntities) on its real player after the mobs each tick, with the statistics map allocated, ticksExisted counted by that update only, motionY -0.0784 and onGround at the start, and the server copy put back at the client x and z after it (a position packet). Row element 5[3] is the player motion (x, y, z); row elements 6 and 7 are whether the copy was onGround when its update began and its y at the start of the tick (inputs the client reports; the replay feeds them). Scenarios: cows and pigs touching, diagonal, coincident, near the 0.01 threshold, a crowd, creative, walking into and through herds, a zombie (touch and hit knockback), witches throwing at a pushed, knocked or walking player and at a knocked cow. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
